svg.title: frontend-flow: one feature from spec to handoff
svg.desc: Ticket found or drafted (a new one needs your approval), spec, you approve, plan, you approve, test plan, branch, build loop per plan step with gates and browser step checks, verify, audit, browser run as each role, handoff with library, commit, PR and Jira drafts each approved, done. The spec file holds the state; the test-case library holds the regression cases and milestone run reports.
svg.text: frontend-flow — one feature, start to finish
/fe:run does one move at a time through the agent that owns it. Amber gates wait for you; the spec file remembers where it stands.
AR key given, found, or drafted
each draft waits for your yes
The spec file — every stage writes here
Flow status · UI plan · Plan · Test plan · Library changes · Decisions · Log
A new session reads it and resumes; the start-up hook lists features in progress.
Test-case library — what must keep working
Use cases + test cases per area · Smoke · Permission
Milestone run reports, with the environment tested
Nothing is committed, pushed or posted without a yes.
